title: AI智能体设计模式二维框架：认知功能与执行拓扑
summary: 提出一个二维分类框架，结合认知功能（7类）和执行拓扑（6种）来系统描述LLM智能体架构。该7x6矩阵识别出27种命名模式，并在金融、法律、网络运维和医疗分诊四个领域验证了覆盖能力。跨领域分析得出五条经验法则，指导环境约束与架构选择之间的关系。
summary_en: Proposes a two-dimensional classification framework combining cognitive function (7 categories) and execution topology (6 archetypes) to systematically describe LLM agent architectures. The 7x6 matrix identifies 27 named patterns, validated across four real-world domains. Cross-domain analysis yields five empirical laws linking environmental constraints to architectural choices.
